The included drift test in [FILE-MAP:R2:2] verifies flow-state preservation only, not canonical evidence file preservation, so mapped evidence omits a required unchanged-canonical-files guarantee.; [REQ:R4] requires provider startup, communication/subprocess, JSON parse/schema, post-hook, canonical evidence write, phase projection, and result-recording failures to be persisted as TOOLING_ERROR outcomes with stage and attempt data. entries.reason: [REQ:R2] requires every review execution to bind phase, taskId-or-null, current tree SHA, provenance, and a CLI-computed canonical evidence digest into ReviewEvidenceIdentity, and to reject malformed evidence before state mutation. The mapped implementation adds ReviewEvidenceIdentity and canonical digest creation in ReviewEvidence, and independent registration validates target fields, but provider review promotion can silently skip identity binding: persistCanonicalReviewArtifact returns null when result.changed is empty, when the expected artifact file is absent, or when flowManager/spec is missing, after which finalizeReviewCommandResult returns the parsed successful review result without rejection or canonical evidence/state mutation. This contradicts the “every review execution shall bind” and malformed-evidence rejection requirements. Sources: [FILE-MAP:R2:4] src/flow/lib/review-convergence.js, [FILE-MAP:R2:5] src/flow/lib/review-evidence-store.js, [FILE-MAP:R2:6] src/flow/lib/run-review.js.; [REQ:R4] requires every listed tooling failure to persist as TOOLING_ERROR outcomes with stage and attempt data, not create review findings, not consume semantic remediation budget, and share one persisted toolingMaxAttempts=1 budget per phase/task/tree target. The diff supplies substantial support for stage/attempt persistence and shared target budget in ReviewToolingOutcome, ReviewConvergenceStore, and ReviewExecutionGuard [FILE-MAP:R4:5] [FILE-MAP:R4:6], but it contradicts the no-review-findings rule for finalized-result tooling failures: NormalizedReviewExecution sets findings = evidence?.findings and handoffFindings from evidence even when toolingOutcome is present, and the added regression test explicitly expects canonical_write TOOLING_ERROR to expose the advisory finding [FILE-MAP:R4:6] [FILE-MAP:R4:2]. This is contrary to the R4 requirement that tooling failures shall not create review findings.
